name: get_course_workspace
description: Return one course workspace combining Paideia materials and pending work with Campus schedule and official grades. Includes live-clock academicContext. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. calendar_unavailable requires verifying and recording a program calendar, not assuming week 1.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
